description: Type the 503 `no_ready_machine` a `failFast` create, resume or fork gets when no machine of that type is ready. The spec documents it on components.responses.NoReadyMachine and on each `failFast` member ("either the usual `202` with the sandbox, or `503` `no_ready_machine` with nothing created, billed, or counted"); it generated as the generic ServiceUnavailable. It carries no httpError trait on purpose: as a 503 it would be classed as a server error and retried for ~20 s, which defeats `failFast` (answer within ~1.5 s so the caller can fall back at once). Source: spec-mirror-boat-dev 71ab00f.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: `failFast` was set and no machine of this type is ready right now. Nothing was started, billed or counted against start limits.
